newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish c.bank to allow more risky investment - paper.
newsitem.headline: Polish c.bank to allow more risky investment - paper.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland plans to allow commercial banks to invest in more risky securities providing that banks will make special reserves to cover the risk, the Nowa Europa daily said.

"The NBP's currency department is preparing a regulation allowing banks to buy higher risk securities under the condition that the bank will make a 100 percent reserve to cover the risk," the financial daily said.

Polish commercial banks have so far only been allowed to buy debt issues of institutions with the highest credit rating and treasuries of countries belonging to the Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development.
The NBP was not immediately available for comment.
